theme_title: Airtel's Gopal Vittal re-elected GSMA chair until 2028
summary: Gopal Vittal has secured re-election as chair of the GSMA Board for the 2027-28 term, marking a decade of impactful service. With a focus on industry trust and security, he aims to shield customers and the mobile ecosystem from threats and scams. The board has also appointed Margherita Della Valle and Ralph Mupita as co-deputy chairs, highlighting a strong leadership team dedicated to enhancing global connectivity.
